name: Meet A Gorilla
summary: “Meet a Gorilla” is a unique VR experience that brings you face-to-face with one of the most fascinating animals on the planet. Step into an immersive environment where you can interact with a gorilla up close, observe its behavior, and explore its world in a way that feels natural and exciting. Whether you’re just hanging out, testing your courage, or exploring the wild, this game offers a mix of fun, surprise, and discovery.
